title: Studio 154 Hotel-River Front Double King w/ Patio
description: The Riverview Suite is one of Studio 154 Luxury Hotel's best accommodations with panoramic views of the Cumberland River from your private enclosed balcony. All guests also have access to the SKYDECK - rooftop with waterfront panoramic views of the Cumberland River and the Nashville skyline.
